title: MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - BLUMENFIELD) relative to a personal services contract with Granicus LLC.
text:
[Council File 26-1605; CD 7]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - BLUMENFIELD) relative to a personal services contract with Granicus LLC.
Recommendations for Council action:
1. APPROVE the attached personal services contract with Granicus LLC for providing services to the Seventh Council District as set forth therein.
2. AUTHORIZE the Councilwomen of the Seventh District to execute this contract on behalf of the City, and that the City Clerk is instructed to encumber the necessary funds against the Contractual Services Account of the Council Fund for Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and to reflect it as a charge against the budget of the involved Council Office.
